TextView.android:text: BetterMe Health requests read-only access to sleep, steps, heart rate, resting heart rate, blood oxygen, exercise, distance, calories and floors in Health Connect, including past data when you allow it. It uploads records to your private BetterMe account only when you tap Sync.\n\nRecords keep their original Health Connect identity and timestamps so repeat syncs update rather than duplicate them. The app does not sell or share health data and does not store your BetterMe PIN. You can revoke access at any time in Health Connect settings.
